mapper.insert: INSERT INTO po_sync_record (purchase_order_no, custom_order_sn, supplier_id, supplier_name, supplier_phone, contact_person, po_status, po_status_text, status_shipped, status_shipped_text, amount_total, total_price, quantity_total, warehouse_name, remark, po_order_time, po_create_time, po_update_time, sync_time) VALUES (#{purchaseOrderNo}, #{customOrderSn}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{supplierPhone}, #{contactPerson}, #{poStatus}, #{poStatusText}, #{statusShipped}, #{statusShippedText}, #{amountTotal}, #{totalPrice}, #{quantityTotal}, #{warehouseName}, #{remark}, #{poOrderTime}, #{poCreateTime}, #{poUpdateTime}, #{syncTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE custom_order_sn = VALUES(custom_order_sn), supplier_id = VALUES(supplier_id), supplier_name = VALUES(supplier_name), supplier_phone = VALUES(supplier_phone), contact_person = VALUES(contact_person), po_status = VALUES(po_status), po_status_text = VALUES(po_status_text), status_shipped = VALUES(status_shipped), status_shipped_text = VALUES(status_shipped_text), amount_total = VALUES(amount_total), total_price = VALUES(total_price), quantity_total = VALUES(quantity_total), warehouse_name = VALUES(warehouse_name), remark = VALUES(remark), po_order_time = VALUES(po_order_time), po_create_time = VALUES(po_create_time), po_update_time = VALUES(po_update_time), sync_time = VALUES(sync_time)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM po_sync_record WHERE po_status = 1 AND contract_created = 0 AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY po_order_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE po_sync_record SET contract_created = 1, contract_id = #{contractId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE purchase_order_no = #{purchaseOrderNo}
